data.title: Rayo Vallecano Protest Ends Athletic Club Match
data.content:
The suspension adds to a disrupted opening stretch for Athletic: three of their first eight league commitments had changed dates. Their match at Levante was postponed because of heavy rain and the condition of the pitch, then rescheduled for October 21. The Vallecas fixture had no replacement date confirmed in Mundo Deportivo’s report. [...] Sánchez Martínez stopped play, and the teams resumed after several minutes. When objects were thrown again, the referee sent the players to the dressing rooms and activated the match protocol. Play restarted once more, but the launches recurred, prompting the definitive suspension. [...] Carmelo Vega Posted by Carmelo Vega
